items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Johnny played clarinet. That's Pijol. I don't remember none of them. I'll tell you the truth. [INTERVIEWEE] I don't, really.

ctx.x: I used to do advertising for them, too, you know, and wagons and everything else, you know.
